violated_contract: A Cloud Tasks OIDC audience must be the URL of the handler that receives the task. Sharing another lane's audience (SYNC_TASKS_OIDC_AUDIENCE / SYNC_TASKS_HANDLER_URL) with a different handler URL makes the receiving service reject the delivery 403 until the queue retry budget is exhausted.
canonical_prevention: Mint and verify the token from the same handler-URL env var as the task's POST URL. Do not fall back to a sibling lane's audience. Pin it with a contract test that sets SYNC_TASKS_* to a different service than AUDIO_MERGE_HANDLER_URL and requires both enqueue and verify to use the merge handler URL.
